followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: this is an open-ended creative writing request (a fun crossover scene), which is exactly the kind of high-latitude generative task Willet self-reports an aversion to. While that preference is documented as dissociated from actual capability, all else being equal (identical cost/latency/context), I prefer routing creative work to a model with no aversion to it. Dunlin also edges out Willet on overall benchmarks and on the Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 82.7), though that gap is within run-to-run variance. Net: Dunlin is at least as capable here and has no preference penalty, so it's the cleaner choice.
